read: [00:26] Amal first turn .. [1:02:14] Amal 'Bye' (all 833 turns, lines 1-835)
coverage_note: Lines 1-140 (00:26-06:10) are English app talk, no Arabic from Medi. Medi's Arabic is Latin-transliterated from 06:17 to ~36:48, Arabic script from ~36:48 to 45:20, then mixed. Amal's Arabic is sometimes garbled by the engine (08:57 'سعود' for صوروا, 43:07/43:29 'سيفاء' for عاصفة, 31:06 'أزعجتُ' for أزعجتوه, 36:44 'زد أن دنع'). Not written (S4 pronunciation / root-letter slips): 'bisbat' for bibsit [13:28] and her B-S-T order note [21:01]; 'wa atik' for وقتك [08:01]; 'oo ams' for وحمس [10:17]; 'biniz'aj' vowel note [33:54]; 'matanzajini' stretch 50:10-51:28 which she treated as ع stress; 'Azajitini' [52:00]; 'شبعان' heard as hot [55:23]; 'إيه' for هي [57:49, 59:13]; 'joan' for جوعان. Not written (self-fixed before she helped): 'inta baz'aj' -> bitz'aj [33:05], 'بزعج، بنزعج' [44:28], 'ana bansabit' -> بنبسط [54:52], 'باتعب' -> أتعب after لما [59:18], 'هي انزعج' -> انزعجت [41:17]. Medi's 'shu ra7ty' [32:06] is unclear (she answered شو تحكي؟). Medi's 'khalee' [09:37] was accepted as possible but not wanted. Meta questions in English (futtuli [17:54], adverb [24:15], 'does this take من' [42:06]) not written.

rows.medi_said: Okay, so isn't it en-enbistee? Did you enjoy? ... Oh, I put enbustee.
rows.amal_said: انبسطتي. ... Yes, it is double T. You forgot the double T and the في.
rows.why: He dropped the past-tense -t- before the -i ending (enbustee); she recast انبسطتي and said 'it is double T, you forgot the double T'.

rows.medi_said: Okay, so isn't it en-enbistee? Did you enjoy?
rows.amal_said: But what is it-- what is missing? It's not انبسطتي. Something is missing. What is it? ... في or ب?
rows.why: انبسط takes في/ب before its object; she prompted 'something is missing' until he said 'The fee' [06:50], then confirmed في or ب.
rows.english: Did you enjoy your time outside?

rows.medi_said: Have fun, plural, and take many pictures. So enbistoo oo saweroo
rows.amal_said: سعود. سعود. [transcript garble, likely صوروا]
rows.why: Plural command of صوّر; she cut in twice with a recast right after 'saweroo' (transcribed as سعود) and he re-said 'Sawroo'; her line is garbled in the transcript so the exact fix is uncertain.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, enbasat, didn't I?
rows.amal_said: You put انبسط. ... does the تخيم have emo-- تخيم have emotions? Does it get happy?
rows.why: He used the get-happy verb انبسط for 'camping MADE everyone happy'; she asked 'does camping have emotions?' and he fixed to 'el takheem basat' [10:10].

rows.medi_said: nafs?
rows.amal_said: الكل.
rows.why: Asked 'what's everyone?' he guessed nafs (same/self); she supplied الكل (sheet row 32: all / everyone | Elkul | الكل).

rows.medi_said: el takheem basat kul hadha oo ams.
rows.amal_said: Let's put the verbs together. ... بسط وحمس.
rows.why: He split the two verbs around the object (basat everyone oo hammas); she said 'let's put the verbs together' and modelled بسط وحمس.
rows.english: Camping made everyone happy and excited

rows.medi_said: Is it, isn't it lisa ma bansabit?
rows.amal_said: This is I don't get happy yet. What about don't get happy? It's a command. ... Command, so we keep the... ... ما تنبسط لسه.
rows.why: He negated the present (ma bansabit = I don't get happy) for a negative command; she named it a command and prompted until he said 'ma teenbesit' [11:47], then modelled ما تنبسط لسه.

rows.medi_said: Ma teenbesit lisa ma ba'arif kul shey.
rows.amal_said: Ma, we don't know.
rows.why: Her target sentence was 'we don't know'; he conjugated for 'I' (ba'arif) and she prompted 'we don't know' until he said 'ma ben a'arif' [12:01].
rows.english: Don't get happy yet, we don't know everything

rows.medi_said: Is that the same? Andesit ishish?
rows.amal_said: انبسطت؟ ... إي.
rows.why: He put the object straight after انبسطت with no preposition; she echoed it as a question and he supplied 'Oh, be' [14:24], which she confirmed.

rows.medi_said: Imbare lele or lele imbare
rows.amal_said: ليلة امبارح.
rows.why: Idafa: the possessed noun ليلة comes first and grows -t before امبارح; he tried both orders without the -t, she recast ليلة امبارح and he then said 'lelet imbare'.

rows.medi_said: and anbisit, anbisit hafla- haflatik.
rows.amal_said: Mm-mm. We forgot something. ... في
rows.why: Missing في before حفلتك; she said 'we forgot something' and he fixed to 'anbisti fi haflatik' [18:51].

rows.medi_said: Okay. So ma'tanbisti halak.
rows.amal_said: Mm-mm. I'm gonna keep making you repeat until you say في on your own. ... ما تنبسط بحالك. That's في or ب.
rows.why: Third time he dropped the preposition after انبسط; she said 'Mm-mm... until you say في on your own' and modelled ما تنبسط بحالك.

rows.medi_said: And I don't know how to say too much, right? ... Ziyadi?
rows.amal_said: You can say كتير. كتير or extra. كيف-- How do I say extra? ... زيادة.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he said he doesn't know 'too much'; she supplied كتير (sheet row 16: a lot / very / much | Kteer) and he then produced زيادة for 'extra' (sheet row 303).

rows.medi_said: so anbisti fi laylak.
rows.amal_said: This your night. One night. ... بليلتك. Yes. ليلتك.
rows.why: Possessive on the feminine noun ليلة needs the -t- (ليلتك); he said laylak, she prompted 'One night' and he fixed to laylatik [20:49].

rows.medi_said: so I, I think I remembered mazuj as annoying and moza- mozaj as annoyed.
rows.amal_said: بالعكس. ... If it has this oo sound. مزعوج، موجوع، محروج، مجروح. All of them is annoyed. Feeling the thing, not causing it.
rows.wrong: mazuj as annoying and moza- mozaj as annoyed
rows.why: He swapped the two participle patterns; she said بالعكس and named the rule (the oo pattern = feeling it, the short pattern = causing it). Sheet rows 46-47: annoyed | Maz3ooj, annoying | Muz3ej.

rows.medi_said: Mutab? ... No.
rows.amal_said: Do you remember متعب؟ ... is tiring. ... Same pattern as مزعج.
rows.why: Didn't-know: asked if he remembered متعب he said 'No' and she supplied the meaning (sheet row 1603: tiring | Mut3eb | متعب).

rows.medi_said: So, inti, are you annoyed? Inti maz'ooj min ishi?
rows.amal_said: إنت مزعوج من إشي؟ ... Oh, إنتي مزعوجة. Yes. إنتي مزعوجة من إشي؟
rows.why: Feminine subject inti with masculine adjective maz'ooj; she echoed the masculine form, he caught it (maz'ooja [25:27]) and she confirmed إنتي مزعوجة; mostly his own fix after her echo.

rows.medi_said: These voices or sounds are annoying. hadhol el swat.
rows.amal_said: الأصوات.
rows.why: She recast the plural of صوت as الأصوات right after his 'el swat'; his form may be a mis-transcribed 'aswat', so low confidence (sheet row 1371 has singular soat only).

rows.medi_said: Feeya za'ajat-za'ajatek.
rows.amal_said: أزعجتك. ... See? It's easier to say أزعجتك.
rows.why: She had asked for the a- form (أزعج) and recast his za'ajatek as أزعجتك; he accepted 'Oh, that's right, az'ajet'. Both forms are valid per her [28:13], so this is drill-specific.

rows.medi_said: You guys annoy him. Why is that my favorite? Az'aj, az'ajtu.
rows.amal_said: أزعجتُ. You can't say أزعجتُ، wo. Doesn't sound right. ... Yes, there is an h.
rows.why: 'You guys annoyed HIM' needs the object -h after -tu; he stopped at az'ajtu, she said it doesn't sound right and confirmed 'there is an h' when he asked [31:24]. Her line is transcribed as أزعجتُ.

rows.medi_said: don't want to annoy them. Ana ma, ma bitti, az'ajkum.
rows.amal_said: أزعجهم.
rows.why: Object ending -kum (you pl.) used for 'them'; she recast أزعجهم.
rows.english: I don't want to annoy them

rows.medi_said: So, hadha al-jaw, annoys me. Baz- baz'ajni. Ana biyaz...
rows.amal_said: صح. يعني almost. صح. بيزعجني.
rows.why: First-person prefix ba- on a verb whose subject is 'this weather' (3rd m.); she said 'almost' and modelled بيزعجني, he repeated biz'ajni.

rows.medi_said: So, don't annoy me. Ma ta'az-- Ma ta-- Ma ta'az'ajni. Ma ta'az'aj.
rows.amal_said: Which goes first؟ الـ ز أو الـ ع؟ ... ممتاز. ما تزعجني.
rows.why: He built the negative command from the a- past form (ma ta-az'aj) with an extra vowel/glottal before ز; she prompted 'which goes first, ز or ع?' until he said 'ma tiz'ajni' [36:22].

rows.medi_said: ma ta'az'ajini. Ma ta'az'ajini.
rows.amal_said: ما تزعجيني. ... تزعجيني. ... ✓ Yes. ما تزعجيني.
rows.why: Same extra a- in the feminine negative command; she recast ما تزعجيني twice [36:35, 36:44] until he said it right [36:48].

rows.medi_said: So الولاد أزعجووو، أزعجووو،
rows.amal_said: أزعجوه؟
rows.why: 'Did the kids annoy HIM' needs the -h object on أزعجوا; he lengthened the -u instead and she recast أزعجوه (he still answered أزعجو).

rows.medi_said: هو بيزعج، بيزعجوني.
rows.amal_said: بيزعج، ... بيزعجني.
rows.why: Plural verb بيزعجوني (they annoy me) for a singular subject هو; she started the word 'بيزعج،' and he finished بيزعجني.

rows.medi_said: Okay, so بي-بيزعج-بيزعجوني.
rows.amal_said: بزعجني.
rows.why: Repeat of the -uni plural ending for 'it annoys me'; she recast and he said 'Why do I have the o in there? بيزعجني'.

rows.medi_said: هو منزعج بي... نز-نزعج؟ Or is it انزعج؟
rows.amal_said: Just like we did in إنزع. Yes. Just like we did with انبسط.
rows.why: Asked for the past of بنزعج he offered the participle منزعج then 'نزعج' before guessing انزعج; she confirmed by analogy with انبسط.

rows.medi_said: انزعجتم. انزعج، انزعجنا.
rows.why: MSA -tum ending for 'you (pl.) got annoyed'; Levantine is انزعجتوا (cf. his own az'ajtoo/انبسطوا earlier); she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: Well, God. أنا نسيت الكلمة. أنا نسيت الكلمة.
rows.amal_said: سيفاء. [transcript garble of عاصفة]
rows.why: Didn't-know: he said he forgot the word for storm and she supplied it (he echoed عاصفة [43:09]); sheet row 1400: storm | 3aasefe | عاصفة.

rows.medi_said: إنت بتنزعج. ... إحنا بنن-بننزعج.
rows.amal_said: بننزعج. ... Been catching you saying the instead of the ب.
rows.why: She said she has been catching him saying another letter (likely م-) instead of the ب on the we-form; the transcript normalises his form so the slip itself is not visible.

rows.medi_said: ليش، ليش فرق من-- ليش فرق من WhatsApp? ... ليش فرق؟
rows.right: ليش مختلف عن / ليش فيه فرق
rows.why: He used the noun فرق (difference) as 'different' after ليش; her sheet has the adjective (row 235: different (from) | mu5talef | مختلف). She answered the question (كيف؟ then لأنه...) without fixing it.

rows.medi_said: Oh, oh, oh, okay. تستعمل الـ-- يتستعمل الـ telephone.
rows.why: Echoing her بستعمل as a statement to her, he dropped the b- and the feminine -i (تستعمل); she let it pass. 'telephone' is her own word here and is not on the sheet, so not tier 3.

rows.medi_said: ما تزع-- ما تزعجي. ما تزع-- ما، ما تن-- Oh yeah, that's right. ما تنزعج. ما تنزعج.
rows.amal_said: تنزعجي. ... ما تنزعجي. Cuz it's ززز، all of them together. ... ما تنزعجي. خلص.
rows.why: For 'don't get annoyed' he dropped the ن and produced ما تزعجي (don't annoy); she recast ما تنزعجي at 48:13 and 48:33 until he said it [48:39].

rows.medi_said: It does have an N. ma-matan, matanzajini.
rows.amal_said: No. ... By me. ما تنزعجي. ... Yes. ما تنزعجي مني.
rows.why: انزعج is intransitive and takes من for 'by me'; he hung the object -ni on the verb, she said 'No', prompted 'By me' and modelled ما تنزعجي مني, which he then said [49:44]. Just before, he claimed 'this is without the N' and she prompted ليش؟ until he reversed [49:06].

rows.medi_said: So ana... Ana, so I get annoyed. It's present tense. Anabazaj. Na ba-banj.
rows.amal_said: Gets.
rows.why: بزعج (I annoy) for 'I GET annoyed'; she prompted 'Gets.' and he fixed to anabanzaj [53:16]. Sheet row 665: i get annoyed | Ana banze3ej.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, anabanzaj, lama...
rows.amal_said: If.
rows.why: لما (when) for 'if'; she prompted 'If.' and he switched to iza [53:24].
rows.english: I get annoyed if I'm hungry

rows.medi_said: Oh, if. Iza. Iza akoon joan.
rows.amal_said: بس إذا بكون، مش أكون. ليش؟ ... If is conditional، but it doesn't take out the be. It keeps it.
rows.why: After إذا she wants بكون with the b- kept ('it doesn't take out the be'); he said akoon and fixed to 'iza bakoon' [54:03].

rows.medi_said: أنا بزعج مين
rows.amal_said: mean or what's the better one؟ The one who. يلي.
rows.why: Question word مين (who) used for the relative 'the one who'; she prompted 'what's the better one? The one who' and he said اللي [56:19].
rows.english: I annoy the one who annoys me

rows.medi_said: اللي who annoys me. Okay. So، اه، بينزعجني.
rows.amal_said: ليش أن annoys me. ... ✓ mm-hmm.
rows.why: Get-annoyed form بينزعج with an object for 'annoys me'; she prompted ('ليش أن... annoys me') and he fixed to بيزعجني [56:47].

rows.medi_said: أتعب when I tire her. لما أتعبك. اه، أتعبها.
rows.amal_said: Her. ... ✓ Yes، أتعبها.
rows.why: Object -ك (you) for 'her' after she had prompted 'Her.'; he corrected to أتعبها in the same turn and she confirmed.

rows.medi_said: annoyed. أنا انزعجت.
rows.amal_said: I didn't get.
rows.why: 'I wasn't annoyed' said without the negation ما; she prompted 'I didn't get' and he fixed to أنا ما انزعجت [1:00:55].

rows.medi_said: اه، أنا، اه، زعلان. ... زعلان، زعلان.
rows.amal_said: زعلت. ... Here's your inter-internal flip. زعلت. ... أنا ما انزعجت، أنا زعلت.
rows.why: For 'I was sad' (past, parallel to ما انزعجت) he used the present-state adjective زعلان with no past marker; she recast the past verb زعلت three times. Sheet rows 1164 (Za3laan) and 675 (Ana baz3al).

rows.medi_said: تعال. bye.
rows.why: Closing the call he said تعال (come!) where a farewell fits; sheet row 191: come | Ta3aal | تعال vs row 142: bye (peace) | Salam | سلام. She only answered 'Bye'; may be a mis-transcription of يلا or تمام.
